attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Hilton Head: Sun, Sea and Science
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary: NPACE's spring conference on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, runs April 5 to 7, 2027, at the Sonesta Resort. Under the subtitle Practical Updates in Patient Care it offers clinical updates for nurse practitioners and other advanced practice providers, with 18+ CE/CME credits listed by NPACE. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $1,050; staying three or more nights at the conference hotel takes $100 off, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.
